coverage.sourceTitle: Bangladesh Public Procurement Authority — Contract Awards
coverage.note: These are five manually transcribed examples from BPPA's public contract-award pages, not a complete export of all government road contracts. The BPPA register is paginated and should be fully ingested before making an all-contractors claim.
coverage.privacy: Only the supplier/legal entity name and award record are shown. Personal phone numbers and addresses from the source are intentionally omitted.
coverage.mapNote: Use project-site geography only where the tender description or project document identifies it. The BPPA 'District' field may describe the procuring entity's administrative location; it is not automatically the construction site's district.
